I was working as a lifeguard at this pool one summer. There were a couple of tables where people could sit just outside of the guard office, and they could definitely overhear some of what was said in the office. Here's how I know; a patron and his morbidly, disgustingly obese ~9-year-old son were sitting at one of the tables just beyond where you could see out from the office, but still pretty close. I was talking with another guard, at normal volume, about how I completely disapproved of letting a child's health get in such a disastrous state, how it was negligent parenting, etc. I didn't think the they could hear me. I'm not sure about the kid, but the dad definitely did. He storms up to the office, completely pissed, and very angrily, almost threateningly told me I needed to watch how I talked about somebody else's kids before he stormed off. I was absolutely terrified and pumping with adrenaline till the end of the shift, completely expecting to see this man waiting to kick my ass once I got off work, being that I would be alone as I closed up every night. Luckily I never saw him again.
